---
title: "Primate BRCA1 Protein Alignment"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(shiny)
library(Biostrings)
library(msa)
library(base64enc)
source("alignment_utils.R")

img_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "primate_images")
if (dir.exists(img_dir)) {
  addResourcePath("species_img", img_dir)
}

species_info <- data.frame(
  scientific = c("Homo sapiens", "Pan troglodytes", "Gorilla gorilla",
    "Pongo pygmaeus", "Hylobates lar", "Macaca mulatta",
    "Papio anubis", "Saimiri sciureus", "Callithrix jacchus"),
  common = c("Human", "Chimpanzee", "Western Gorilla",
    "Bornean Orangutan", "White-handed Gibbon", "Rhesus Macaque",
    "Olive Baboon", "Common Squirrel Monkey", "Common Marmoset"),
  group = c("Great Ape", "Great Ape", "Great Ape",
    "Great Ape", "Lesser Ape", "Old World Monkey",
    "Old World Monkey", "New World Monkey", "New World Monkey"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

species_img_uris <- sapply(species_info$scientific, function(sp) {
  safe_name <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
  img_file <- normalizePath(paste0("primate_images/", safe_name, ".png"), mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(img_file)) {
    raw <- readBin(img_file, "raw", file.info(img_file)$size)
    paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64encode(raw))
  } else ""
})

all_seqs <- readAAStringSet("primate_BRCA1.fasta")
aligned_seqs <- readAAStringSet("primate_BRCA1_aligned.fasta")
aligned_chars <- as.character(aligned_seqs)
full_alignment_html <- build_alignment_html(aligned_chars, "full", aa_colors, label_width = 210, img_uris = species_img_uris)
```

## Select Subset

Optionally select species to re-align a subset.

```{r species-selector, results='asis'}
cat('
<style>
  .sp-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 2px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .sp-card.selected {
    border-color: #566db0;
    background: #f0f4ff;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .sp-card.deselected {
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  .sp-card img {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    object-fit: contain;
  }
  .sp-name {
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .sp-common {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #666;
  }
</style>
')

cat('<div id="species-grid" style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:12px; margin:16px 0;">')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(species_info))) {
  sp <- species_info$scientific[i]
  safe <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
  uri <- paste0("species_img/", safe, ".png")
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="sp-card deselected" data-species="', sp, '" onclick="toggleSpecies(this)">',
    '<img src="', uri, '">',
    '<div>',
    '<div class="sp-name">', sp, '</div>',
    '<div class="sp-common">', species_info$common[i], ' (', species_info$group[i], ')</div>',
    '</div></div>'
  ))
}
cat('</div>')

cat('
<script>
function toggleSpecies(el) {
  el.classList.toggle("selected");
  el.classList.toggle("deselected");
  updateShinySelection();
}
function updateShinySelection() {
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll(".sp-card.selected");
  var selected = [];
  cards.forEach(function(c) { selected.push(c.getAttribute("data-species")); });
  Shiny.setInputValue("selected_species", selected);
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  setTimeout(function() { Shiny.setInputValue("selected_species", []); }, 300);
});
</script>
')
```

```{r align-button}
fluidRow(
  column(12, style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;",
    actionButton("align", "Re-Align Subset", class = "btn-primary",
      style = "background:#566db0; border:none; color:white; padding:10px 24px; font-size:16px;"),
    tags$div(id = "align-spinner", style = "display:none; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
      HTML('<div style="width:18px; height:18px; border:2px solid #ddd; border-top:2px solid #566db0; border-radius:50%; animation:spin 0.8s linear infinite;"></div>
        <span style="color:#666; font-size:13px;">Aligning...</span>
        <style>@keyframes spin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } }</style>')
    ),
    tags$script(HTML("
      $(document).on('click', '#align', function() {
        $('#align-spinner').css('display', 'flex');
      });
      $(document).on('shiny:idle', function() {
        $('#align-spinner').css('display', 'none');
      });
    "))
  )
)
```

```{r subset-alignment-logic}
observeEvent(input$align, {
  req(length(input$selected_species) >= 2)
  selected_seqs <- all_seqs[names(all_seqs) %in% input$selected_species]
  aln <- msa(selected_seqs, method = "ClustalOmega")
  aln_chars <- as.character(unmasked(as(aln, "AAMultipleAlignment")))
  output$subset_alignment <- renderUI({
    HTML(build_alignment_html(aln_chars, "subset", aa_colors, label_width = 210, img_uris = species_img_uris))
  })
})
uiOutput("subset_alignment")
```
